tour.title: International Study Tour 2026
tour.theme: From Grassroots to Digital: Health System Transformation and Universal Care in Vietnam
tour.venue: Courtyard by Marriott Danang Han River
tour.location: 58 Bach Dang Street, Hai Chau Ward, Da Nang, Vietnam

days.venue: Courtyard by Marriott Danang Han River

sessions.title: Group Arrivals & Airport Transfers
sessions.description: Airport pickup with VIP greeting and transfer to Courtyard by Marriott Danang Han River. Hotel check-in and leisure time.

sessions.title: Welcome Reception
sessions.description: Evening reception to meet fellow delegates, Australian faculty, and Vietnamese healthcare hosts.

sessions.title: Welcome & Orientation: Vietnam's Healthcare Journey
sessions.description: Introduction to Vietnamese healthcare leaders and Australian faculty. Overview of tour itinerary, learning expectations, and CPD accreditation pathways.

sessions.title: Opening Keynote: Vietnam's Universal Health Journey — Laying Digital Foundations for Equitable Care
sessions.description: National policy landscape, universal coverage milestones, and national digital health strategic directions.

sessions.title: Welcome Dinner at The Landmark
sessions.description: Vietnamese-fusion welcome dinner setting the collaborative tone for the study tour week.

days.venue: The East Room, Marriott Courtyard & Da Nang Hospital

sessions.title: Keynote Session 1: Universal Health Coverage on the Front Lines — Lessons from Da Nang Hospital's Transformation Journey
sessions.description: Frontline operational perspective on balancing clinical complexity, high patient volumes, and universal health insurance.

sessions.title: Morning Tea & Networking Break
sessions.description: Informal peer discussions with Australian delegates and clinical leaders.

sessions.title: Keynote Session 2: Financing Universal Health — Building Sustainable Models for Equitable Access in Vietnam
sessions.description: Reimbursement mechanisms, social health insurance solvency, and financial sustainability frameworks.

sessions.title: Panel Discussion & Interactive Q&A
sessions.description: Cross-comparative analysis of public healthcare financing and resource constraints in Australia vs. Vietnam.

sessions.title: Lunch & Networking Break
sessions.description: Buffet luncheon at Marriott Courtyard.

sessions.title: Transfer to Public Tertiary Hospital
sessions.description: Coordinated coach transfer with ADBA tour leaders.

sessions.title: Hospital Site Visit: Public Tertiary Hospital Guided Tour
sessions.leads: Executives & Clinical Leads (Host Tertiary Hospital), Dr Anand Ponniraivan (ADBA Delegation Lead)
sessions.description: Behind-the-scenes guided tour focusing on clinical pathways, insurance-driven workflow, workforce management, and small-group discussions with department leads.

sessions.title: Return Coach Transfer to Marriott Courtyard
sessions.description: Transfer and relaxation time before evening functions.

sessions.title: Welcome Drinks at The Summit Room
sessions.description: Panoramic river views with pre-dinner refreshments.

sessions.title: Dinner at The Summit Room & Featured Civic Address
sessions.topic: Danang's Vision: Building a Smart, Healthy, and Inclusive City for the Future
sessions.description: Official city leadership dinner highlighting urban health development and foreign cooperation.

days.venue: The East Room, Marriott Courtyard & Central Danang

sessions.title: Keynote Session 3: Bridging the Gap — How Digital Health and Telemedicine are Transforming Tertiary Patient Care
sessions.description: Case study on private tertiary care telemedicine networks, electronic medical records, and digital triage.

sessions.title: Morning Tea & Networking Break
sessions.description: Coffee, tea, and delegate conversations.

sessions.title: Keynote Session 4: Beyond Boundaries — Public-Private Collaboration and Digital Innovation in Vietnam's Health Sector
sessions.description: Architectures for health tech adoption, AI diagnostics, interoperability, and enterprise health data governance.

sessions.title: Panel Discussion & Interactive Q&A
sessions.description: Translating private-sector digital agility into public hospital and outpatient clinical environments.

sessions.title: Lunch & Networking Break
sessions.description: Luncheon prior to afternoon cultural discovery.

sessions.title: Half Day City Tour: Han Market & Local Cultural Life
sessions.description: Depart from hotel to explore Han Market, meet local vendors, experience Danang commercial life and souvenir bargaining.

sessions.title: Excursion: Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son)
sessions.description: Guided walking tour through natural limestone caves, historic pagodas, and panoramic viewpoints.

sessions.title: Seafood Dinner at My Hanh Seafood Restaurant
sessions.description: Fresh coastal seafood dinner overlooking My Khe Beach.

sessions.title: Transfer Back to Marriott Courtyard
sessions.description: Coach transfer and evening at leisure.

days.venue: UNESCO World Heritage Hoi An Ancient Town

sessions.title: Pickup at Hotel & Scenic Drive to Hoi An
sessions.description: Air-conditioned private coach transfer through the coastal countryside.

sessions.title: Basket Boat Experience in Bay Mau Coconut Forest
sessions.description: Traditional round basket boat excursion through tranquil waterways and water coconut palm groves.

sessions.title: Transfer to Reu Restaurant, Hoi An
sessions.description: Short transfer to relaxation venue.

sessions.title: Relaxation Foot Massage Experience
sessions.description: Traditional herbal foot massage treatment designed for relaxation and delegate rejuvenation.

sessions.title: Traditional Luncheon at Reu Restaurant, Hoi An
sessions.description: Authentic Central Vietnamese culinary tasting menu.

sessions.title: Guided Walking Tour: UNESCO Ancient Town of Hoi An
sessions.description: Exploration of historic Japanese Covered Bridge, ancient merchant residences, and traditional Chinese assembly halls.

sessions.title: Explore Hoi An at Leisure
sessions.description: Free time for artisan boutique shopping, tailor visits, and riverside cafes.

sessions.title: Thu Bon River Boat Trip & Paper Lantern Release
sessions.description: Evening wooden boat cruise releasing traditional glowing paper lanterns onto the tranquil river.

sessions.title: Welcome Drinks & Dinner at Vy Market (Morning Glory Signature)
sessions.location: Vy Market, Third Floor, Hoi An
sessions.description: Iconic culinary dinner celebrating Hoi An street food traditions crafted to fine-dining standards.

sessions.title: Transfer Back to Marriott Courtyard Danang
sessions.description: Coach transfer and restful evening.

days.shortTitle: Primary Care, Private Clinics & Peninsula Gala
days.venue: The East Room & InterContinental Son Tra

sessions.title: Keynote Session 5: Integrating Public and Private Care — Building Sustainable Primary Health Models in Vietnam
sessions.description: Three decades of experience establishing international standard primary care, emergency response, and bilingual clinics in Vietnam.

sessions.title: Morning Tea & Networking Break
sessions.description: Refreshments and clinical networking.

sessions.title: Keynote Session 6: Scaling Quality Care — Private Sector Innovations and Community Impact at Pasteur General Clinic
sessions.description: Operational scalability, diagnostic imaging investments, and outpatient patient retention in regional urban centers.

sessions.title: Panel Discussion & Interactive Q&A
sessions.description: Comparing primary practice models: Private billing in Australia vs. consumer out-of-pocket dynamics in Vietnam.

sessions.title: Lunch & Networking Break
sessions.description: Buffet luncheon at Marriott Courtyard.

sessions.title: Delegate Free Afternoon: Danang City, Beaches, Spa or Shopping
sessions.description: Open leisure time for delegates to explore My Khe beach, indulge in wellness therapies, or relax.

sessions.title: Depart Hotel for Son Tra Peninsula
sessions.description: Scenic mountain and coastal drive.

sessions.title: Welcome Drinks & Dinner at Terra Mare
sessions.location: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, Son Tra
sessions.description: Luxury dinner at one of the world's premier architectural resorts, exploring bilateral healthcare cooperation.

sessions.title: Transfer Back to Marriott Courtyard
sessions.description: Return coach transfer.

days.shortTitle: Hospital Site Visit, Ba Na Hills & Gala Night
days.venue: Accredited Medical Center, Ba Na Hills & Marriott Courtyard

sessions.title: Depart Hotel for Hospital Site Visit
sessions.description: Coach transfer.

sessions.title: Hospital Site Visit: Advanced Medical Technology & Digital Health Center
sessions.leads: Hospital Clinical & Administrative Leadership, Dr Jemma Hogan (ADBA Delegation Lead)
sessions.description: Comprehensive tour of accredited tertiary facilities, robotic surgery suites, telemedicine command hubs, and digital leadership discussions.

sessions.title: Morning Tea & Networking Break
sessions.description: Light refreshments on site.

sessions.title: Capstone Workshop: Translating Lessons to Australian Practice — System, Business, and Clinical Takeaways
sessions.description: Facilitated peer workshop and action planning: synthesising digital workflows, public-private synergies, and business leadership strategies for Australian practice.

sessions.title: Lunch at Madame Lan Restaurant
sessions.description: Famous riverside Vietnamese culinary experience in Danang.

sessions.title: Depart for Ba Na Hills
sessions.description: Coach transfer to the foot of Truong Son mountain range.

sessions.title: Cable Car Ascent to Ba Na Hills
sessions.description: World record-holding cable car journey above lush rainforest canopies.

sessions.title: Explore Golden Bridge & Ba Na Mountain Landmark
sessions.description: Walking along the iconic Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, French Village, and Le Jardin d'Amour.

sessions.title: Transfer Back to Marriott Courtyard
sessions.description: Descent and coach transfer to hotel to prepare for the closing gala.

sessions.title: Welcome Drinks — Private Room
sessions.description: Cocktails and delegate gathering.

sessions.title: Closing Remarks & Study Tour Wrap-Up
sessions.description: Summary of Vietnam Study Tour key learnings, CPD certificate conferral framework, and official announcement of the 2027 Study Tour.

sessions.title: Celebratory Gala Dinner at The East + West Rooms
sessions.location: The East + West Rooms, Marriott Courtyard, Danang
sessions.description: Formal multi-course celebration dinner with entertainment and recognition.

sessions.title: Buffet Breakfast & Check-Out
sessions.description: Full gourmet breakfast buffet, luggage handling, and room checkout.

sessions.title: Group Airport Transfers
sessions.description: Scheduled VIP transfers to Da Nang International Airport for connecting flights.

sessions.title: Optional Last-Minute Stroll or Riverside Coffee
sessions.description: For delegates with late departures, enjoy a morning stroll along the Han River waterfront or local cafes.
